facts.fact: Ghana's Data Protection Commission, through its Director of Regulatory and Compliance Quintin Akrobotu, ran compliance checks and a week-long enforcement exercise under Section 81 of the Data Protection Act.

The Data Protection Commission directed named companies including Menkish Impex Ltd, Polytex Ghana Limited and JA Biney Packaging to report to the CID and the Commission and regularise their registration, for operating unregistered or with expired certificates.
The Data Protection Commission is acting under the Data Protection Act, conducting compliance checks and enforcement, as its Director of Regulatory and Compliance said.

The Commission said the week-long exercise was conducted under Section 81 of the Data Protection Act, with Section 53 prohibiting processing without registration and Section 58 requiring a data protection supervisor.
The Commission cited six named companies for operating unregistered or with expired certificates and directed them to report to the CID and the Commission by 15 October 2026.
